__meta: REUSABLE. IVR availability (RED: Errors as reliability). Stat, percentunit, thresholds red / yellow@0.95 / green@0.99, noValue 100% — the reliability-stat archetype from the reference dashboard (llm/acs reliability), retargeted at AppRequests success ratio.
title: IVR availability
description: Successful requests / total requests over the window. Green ≥ 99%, amber ≥ 95%.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated $__timeFilter()
| summarize Total = count(), Failures = countif(Success == false)
| project Availability = iff(Total == 0, 1.0, 1.0 - todouble(Failures) / Total)
